name: au-fbt-year
description: Use this skill whenever asked about the Australian FBT annual cycle -- the FBT year (1 April to 31 March, not the income year), return lodgment dates (21 May self, 25 June agent-electronic), quarterly BAS instalments and variation, what goes in the return (Type 1/2 grossed-up aggregates, employee contributions, otherwise-deductible), the STP/RFBA interplay (reported by 14 July against the following income year), small-employer annual RFBA reporting, paper-to-digital transition, and exemption/rebate reconciliation. Trigger on "FBT year end", "FBT return", "FBT instalment", "vary FBT", "RFBA timing", "FBT due date". Read au-fbt first for benefit-level computation; this skill covers the CYCLE.
